Your Egyptologist handles the oasis archaeology, the Oracle, the Shali ruins and the rock-cut tombs at Gebel al-Mawta; the 4×4 desert drivers handle the off-road country and the Great Sand Sea crossing.

inclusions.text: One night camping in the White Desert
inclusions.source: Character · Fully private · your own Egyptologist + 4×4 desert drivers · one night camping in the White Desert · two long desert drives; Adrère Amellal ecolodge available in Siwa on request

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo to Bahariya
itinerary.source: The opening stretch begins with a departure from Cairo after breakfast and a four-hour drive southwest into the Western Desert.

itinerary.title: The Black Desert and the White Desert
itinerary.source: Camp is set up here, under the formations and the open sky.

itinerary.title: Crystal Mountain and the Valley of Agabat
itinerary.source: The night returns to Bahariya, with dinner and a final oasis night before the long drive west.

itinerary.title: The long road to Siwa
itinerary.source: Arrival is in the evening; dinner is in Siwa, and the night is used to rest before a full day in the oasis.

itinerary.title: Siwa: Shali ruins, Oracle, springs
itinerary.source: Siwa's distinctive ecolodge, Adrère Amellal — built from salt rock and palm beams at the foot of the White Mountain, lit by candles and without electricity by design — can be requested for those who want the cultural experience of staying inside the oasis's architectural vocabulary rather than at a conventional hotel; otherwise the night is at a Siwa hotel.

itinerary.title: The Great Sand Sea
itinerary.source: The return to Siwa is in the early evening.

itinerary.title: Last morning in Siwa, road back
itinerary.source: Lunch in Siwa, then the long drive back to Cairo, arriving in the evening.
